scenarios.name: Parameter interface follows the active model state

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
the user creates an undimensioned rectangular sketch and extrudes it 1 in with zero taper
the user creates model states Capture State and Copy State and activates Copy State
the user adds d0 and d1 to the model-state table and sets Copy State d0 to 1 in + 0.5 in and d1 to 5 degrees
the user accepts and closes the model-state table
The MCAD Software has a Primary model state with d0 set to 1 in
Copy State has d0 set to "1 in + 0.5 in"
d0 shows the arithmetic equation and nominal and model values of 1.5 in
the user closes Parameters and activates Primary
d0 shows equation 1 in and nominal and model values of 1 in
